incidents.name: Minor Containment Leak
incidents.description: A small leak was detected in the artifact containment unit. The artifact was briefly exposed to ambient conditions.
observations: Containment breach detected. Artifact surface briefly exposed to air.
Minor seal failure. Artifact integrity appears unaffected.

incidents.name: Equipment Malfunction
incidents.description: One of the measurement instruments malfunctioned during an experiment, producing unreliable data.
observations: Instrument calibration drift detected during measurement cycle.
Sensor array returned anomalous readings. Recalibration required.

incidents.name: Unexpected Gravitational Reading
incidents.description: A sudden gravitational anomaly was recorded near the artifact. All personnel reported momentary disorientation.
observations: Gravitational sensor spike detected. Duration: 0.3 seconds.
All personnel within 5m reported brief vertigo. Artifact appeared unchanged.

incidents.name: Power Surge
incidents.description: A power surge affected the laboratory. Several instruments need recalibration.
observations: Power fluctuation detected. All instruments momentarily affected.
Electrical surge caused brief data loss in recording systems.

incidents.name: Researcher Stress Incident
incidents.description: One of the researchers reported unusual symptoms after prolonged exposure to the artifact.
observations: Researcher reported headaches and vivid dreams after extended artifact proximity.
Staff member requesting reassignment. Claims artifact 'hums' at night.

incidents.name: Artifact Mass Fluctuation
incidents.description: The artifact's measured mass fluctuated unexpectedly during a routine check.
observations: Artifact mass readings fluctuated by 0.3% over 10 minutes.
Scale calibration appears stable. Artifact mass variation is real.
